title: Hybrid UX: lazy gateway tool, /mcp command suite, packaging polish

description: Domain: describe renderer + gateway tool catalog types
details:
Add domain/describe-render.ts: pure function renderToolHelp(bridgedTool) → readable text block (params with type, enum values, required, defaults) from the sanitized schema; and domain/tool-catalog.ts: in-memory ToolCatalog type keyed by server → bridged tool metadata, with lookup by bridged name. Both pure, <100 lines each.

Tests: renderer covers enum/optional/required/nested-object cases; catalog lookup + collision behavior.

Verify: `npm test` green; domain purity grep clean.
notes: npm test passes; domain purity grep clean

details:
Extend ConnectionManager with ensureConnected(name): connects a lazy (or idle) server on demand, single-flight per server, returns ready connection or a failure reason. Add application/gateway.ts: handleGatewayAction({action, server?, tool?, args?}) implementing list/describe/call semantics from the handoff, reusing sync-tools bridging to populate the ToolCatalog (registration skipped for lazy servers) and the existing call-tool use case for `call`. Malformed args JSON → thrown Error with the JSON parse message and a hint that args must be a JSON string.

Tests (fake ports): list without server, list with server triggers connect-once, describe renders help, call round-trip, malformed args error, single-flight ensureConnected.

Verify: `npm test` green; application/ still SDK-free (grep).
notes: npm test passes; application purity grep clean

description: Register the mcp gateway pi tool + wire lazy servers in comp
details:
infrastructure/gateway-tool.ts: pi.registerTool definition named `mcp` (label "MCP Gateway") with StringEnum action param, `args` as JSON-string param, promptSnippet and promptGuidelines exactly as specified in the handoff; execute delegates to the gateway use case; text output truncated with pi truncateHead defaults. Composition root: register the gateway only when the catalog has ≥1 lazy server; lazy servers excluded from startAll; session summary line now counts lazy servers as "lazy (on-demand)".

Verify: `npm test` green. Manual: temp dir config with {"everything": {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything"], "lazy": true}}; run `pi -e …/extensions/mcp -p "use the mcp tool to list servers, then call echo with message hi on the everything server"` — gateway lists, connects on demand, call succeeds. STOP if tool registration order causes the gateway to miss the system prompt.
notes: npm test passes; gateway manually deferred because server-everything npx invocation not run yet

details:
Precondition: none — commands only add runtime behaviors; `/mcp auth reset` clears user credential data files at runtime via the existing CredentialStorePort, and `/mcp disconnect` closes live connections; no codebase target is removed.

infrastructure/commands/ (one file per subcommand, <100 lines each, plus a dispatcher): register `/mcp` with getArgumentCompletions offering subcommands (status, connect, disconnect, tools, reload, auth) and server-name completion for the ones taking a server. Implement per handoff: status (multi-line summary), connect/disconnect, tools (bridged + skipped w/ reasons), reload (re-read sources → diff whole-entry → connect new/changed, report added/removed/unchanged counts; direct tools of removed servers stay registered but fail fast with a clear message — documented pi limitation), auth reset (guarded no-op with notice when the credential store isn't wired, i.e. mcp-remote-auth not yet merged).

Tests: dispatcher routing + completions list; reload diff logic as a pure function (extract to application/reload-diff.ts) with add/change/remove cases.

Verify: `npm test` green; manual `/mcp status` and `/mcp tools <server>` against the everything server show sane output.
notes: npm test passes; connect authorizes needs-auth then syncs using fake ports

details:
infrastructure/widget.ts: renderWidgetLine(connections) → `MCP: N servers · M tools · K needs auth · J failed` (omit zero segments); composition root calls ctx.ui.setWidget("mcp", [line]) on session_start, after each state change (connect/disconnect/auth/reload/list_changed), and clears the widget (setWidget with empty content per pi docs) when no servers are configured. Guard all UI calls with ctx.hasUI.

Tests: renderWidgetLine cases (pure).

Verify: `npm test` green; manual: widget visible with servers configured, absent in a dir with no MCP config.
notes: npm test passes; widget UI calls are guarded by ctx.hasUI

description: README rewrite, packaging polish, release readiness
details:
README full rewrite: hybrid model explanation (direct vs lazy + when to choose), gateway usage transcript (list→describe→call), /mcp command reference table, full config reference (standard keys, pi keys: enabled/lazy/includeTools/excludeTools/oauth/oauthPort, precedence), security notes (trust gating, token storage), DDD layout map, comparison note vs pi-mcp-adapter (proxy-only) crediting prior art. Verify package.json files allowlist ships extensions (minus __tests__), bin, docs? (no — keep npm tarball lean: extensions, bin, README, CHANGELOG, LICENSE, package.json). Copy release-please-config.json + .release-please-manifest.json + CI workflow shape from ../pi-plan-mode if publishing via the same pipeline. Bump keywords: pi-package, mcp, model-context-protocol.

Verify: `npm pack --dry-run` lists only intended files; `npm test` green; every file <100 lines; commit clean.
notes: npm test and npm pack --dry-run pass; npm tarball contains only intended package files
